title: Blockprint Graphic
description: Un style graphique très contrasté imitant la linogravure ou l'impression au bloc. Il présente des silhouettes épaisses et massives avec des détails nets sculptés dans l'espace négatif et des contours géométriques irréguliers, sous forme d'art vectoriel bicolore plat.
description_en: A high-contrast graphic style mimicking traditional linocut or block printing. It features thick, chunky silhouettes with crisp, carved negative space details and irregular geometric contours, rendered as flat duotone vector art.
description_fr: Un style graphique très contrasté imitant la linogravure ou l'impression au bloc. Il présente des silhouettes épaisses et massives avec des détails nets sculptés dans l'espace négatif et des contours géométriques irréguliers, sous forme d'art vectoriel bicolore plat.
prompt: Bold blockprint vector graphic technique and heavy ink stamp aesthetic. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Rendered as flat duotone graphic art, utilizing solid {{primary_color}} silhouettes with stark, carved negative space detailing against a flat {{secondary_color}} environment. Eliminate all gradients, soft shading, subsurface scattering, and 3D lighting entirely. Form and depth must be defined exclusively by thick, chunky contours and crisp internal cutouts that mimic traditional linocut carving techniques. The edge treatment is sharp and hard-edged but deliberately features slight geometric irregularities, reflecting the tactile nature of physical stamp pressing and carved linoleum without introducing simulated noise or grain. Minimal {{accent_color}} is permitted, used strictly for stark, unblended graphic accents within the carved areas. Maintain flat 2D spatial dynamics, focusing on interlocking geometric and organic shapes that create a bold, meandering rhythm across the entire composition. The atmospheric register is stark, purely graphic, and highly stylized. video.motion: Subjects and scene elements shift with a stepped, low-framerate stop-motion feel, mimicking the swapping of physical carved blocks. Shapes morph through abrupt, chunky vector interpolations rather than smooth fluid motion.
video.camera: The camera remains entirely static, treating the composition as a fixed 2D graphic poster without any parallax or perspective shifts.
video.temporal_texture: The solid ink colors and sharp carved edges remain completely uniform and flicker-free, avoiding any organic grain or lighting changes.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth 60fps interpolation, 3D camera sweeps, motion blur, gradient transitions, or any dynamic lighting effects.
